copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成符合税务规范的发票

howto.what: 生成一份 A4 可打印的发票单页，包含发票号、日期、寄件/收件方、明细表（描述/数量/单价/金额）、税额与总额、付款指引，并自带打印样式。
howto.when: 当用户要求开发票、账单或付款单时触发，例如提到“发票”“账单”等关键词。

say.text: 给我开一张发票，金额500元，明细写咨询费。
say.note: 会生成含税和总额的A4发票。

say.text: 生成一份发票，包含寄件人和收件人信息。
把这张发票改成可打印的A4格式。

howto.what_en: Generates an A4 printable invoice page with invoice number, date, from/bill-to, line items (description, qty, unit price, amount), tax breakdown, totals, and payment instructions, plus print styles.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to create an invoice, bill, or payment sheet, e.g., mentions 'invoice' or 'bill'.

say_en.text: Please create an invoice for $500, item as consulting fee.
say_en.note: Generates an invoice with tax and total.

say_en.text: Generate an invoice with sender and recipient info.
Convert this invoice to a printable A4 format.
